analysis: Examined four changes. (1) docs/reports/README.md adds one index link at head line 7 to a 2026-10-21 mixed-step prefill geometry report. This is documentation only, with no security-control change. The target file is not in the supplied evidence, so its content is unreviewed. (2) SchedulerPrefillBenchmark.swift (benchmark-only target, not on the serving path) bumps the report schema from 4 to 5 and adds optional prefillChunkTokens and maxBatchedTokensPerStep. It replaces EngineV2Factory.soloPrefillStripeTokens(abovePlainChunk:model:) with EngineV2Factory.prefillGeometry(model:). The base text at lines 154-167 and the patch show the call replaced inside container.perform. The new factory API and the PrefillGeometry type are outside the supplied evidence. The benchmark builds engines via makeProductionBuild with constructionPurpose .benchmark and does not touch the prefix cache, SSD tier, keys or attestation. It has no coordinator, auth, encryption or billing interaction. The new fields are non-sensitive numeric geometry values. (3) The libs/mlx-swift-lm submodule pointer moves from 889fe3c to c8dce97. The submodule contents are not supplied. The pointer is on the inference-engine dependency path (TB-007, in-process MLX, plaintext prompts and KV in memory). It may carry the changed prefill geometry, meaning 2,048/4,096 prompt chunks and a Gemma 4 media ceiling, which could change activation memory, admission, the cache-adoption bound used by T-041's per-donation gate, and DoS or memory behavior (T-029, T-010). I cannot verify any of this. No finding is raised because there is no visible evidence of a regression. Remaining questions: review the submodule diff, and the EngineV2Factory.prefillGeometry change (likely in another batch), for changes to cache-adoption bounds, SSD donation gating, the at-rest format or AAD, media size limits, and cancellation. Human review of the submodule diff is advisable.
